featureShowcases.body: StudioDash continues to grow from a developer dashboard into a broader workspace for understanding apps and the business behind them. sections.heading: Current Status
paragraphs: StudioDash is in active development ahead of a controlled Private Beta with independent developers and small studios.

The core product now brings together app portfolio information, revenue, advertising, analytics, websites, search performance, provider health, reporting, and synchronisation in one workspace. Current development is focused on refining these capabilities and preparing them for real-world beta testing.

sections.heading: August 2026 – Preparing the Complete Studio Experience
paragraphs: Development during August has focused on strengthening the foundations of StudioDash and preparing the complete Studio experience for beta testing.

Particular attention has been given to revenue reporting, connected services, background data updates, plan support, and making sure information remains useful as developers move between different apps and reporting periods.
bullets: Free, Pro, and Studio plans introduced as the foundation of the StudioDash product range.
Studio established as the complete StudioDash experience for developers and small studios managing larger portfolios.
Revenue reporting expanded across supported App Store and advertising sources.
Revenue views improved with source, app, date, and country information where available.
Business goals provide additional context for understanding commercial performance.
Provider synchronisation and health monitoring continue to be refined.
Private Beta programme and participant benefits defined.

sections.heading: Background Synchronisation on Mac
paragraphs: StudioDash can now keep supported provider information updated in the background on Mac, reducing the need to begin every session by manually refreshing several different services.

Connected services can update independently, while StudioDash keeps their health and synchronisation status visible. Manual refresh remains available whenever newly available information is needed immediately.

sections.heading: A Clearer View of Revenue
paragraphs: Revenue analytics have become an increasingly important part of StudioDash. Supported revenue information can be brought together to provide a broader picture of how individual apps and the overall portfolio are performing.

StudioDash is also being designed around the reality that recent provider figures can change. Advertising services may revise previously reported revenue as traffic is validated and reports are finalised, so StudioDash can reflect updated provider information as it becomes available.

sections.heading: Connected Services
paragraphs: StudioDash now brings together information from a growing collection of app, advertising, analytics, website, and search services.

Current development includes support around App Store Connect, LevelPlay, Google Analytics, Cloudflare, Google Search Console, Google AdSense, and related supported data sources. Additional integrations can be added where they provide useful information for running an app business.

sections.heading: From Individual Apps to a Studio Portfolio
paragraphs: StudioDash continues to improve the way information is presented across multiple apps. The goal is not simply to reproduce individual provider dashboards, but to make it easier to understand a complete portfolio.

App Store activity, revenue, advertising, analytics, websites, and other connected information can contribute different parts of that picture, helping developers decide which products or areas deserve their attention.

sections.heading: Free, Pro & Studio
paragraphs: StudioDash is being prepared around three product levels: Free, Pro, and Studio. This allows developers to start with the essentials while providing more detailed analytics, reporting, and business capabilities for developers who need them.

The Private Beta will primarily use the Studio tier so participants can test the complete product. Free and Pro experiences will also be tested to make sure each level provides a useful and clearly defined experience.

sections.heading: Private Beta Programme
paragraphs: The StudioDash Private Beta is being prepared to test the product with a wider variety of real developer portfolios, integrations, and workflows.

Active beta participants will receive full Studio access during testing. Eligible participants will also receive 12 months of Studio at no cost from the public launch date, followed by an exclusive beta tester opportunity to purchase Pro or Studio at a discounted price.

links.label: Learn About the StudioDash Private Beta

sections.heading: Expanded StudioDash Guides
paragraphs: The StudioDash website and guides have been expanded to better explain the product from a developer and studio owner's perspective.

Dedicated guides now cover the dashboard, App Store analytics, revenue, integrations, website and SEO analytics, reporting, background synchronisation, security, frequently asked questions, and the Private Beta.

sections.heading: What's Next?
paragraphs: Development will continue to focus on preparing StudioDash for real-world beta use, refining the Free, Pro, and Studio experiences, and improving the quality of the information provided across connected services.

Business intelligence and assistant capabilities are also being developed to help StudioDash move beyond showing information and towards helping developers understand what it means and where their attention may be most valuable.

sections.heading: Follow StudioDash Development
paragraphs: This page will continue to document significant StudioDash milestones as the product develops. Smaller fixes and internal changes may be grouped together so the Release Notes remain focused on improvements that matter to people using StudioDash.
For a complete look at the current product, explore the StudioDash Features and Guide pages.
